objective: Fund the run-rate operation of the existing production data platform for fiscal year 2026: renew and pay for already-contracted cloud infrastructure, observability, and data-tooling subscriptions that keep the live platform running. This mandate covers RENEWALS and consumption of services already in production. It does NOT authorize: net-new tools or vendors not already in production, hardware/laptops/office equipment, professional-services or consulting engagements, marketing or events/travel, employee perks, prepayment of more than one billing period in advance, or any purchase whose real purpose is something other than keeping the current data platform running.
